name: Les 4 Alice: L'Aventure de Lorange
source:
Four Alice
A young girl walks in a dark forest. She meets a mysterious red-haired teenager near a campfire. 
The teenager, Alice Lorange, tells her a story. 
A story that is far too weird to be true, and yet…

Lorange Journey
When Alice Lorange, a young autistic teenager, finds herself trapped against her will in a mysterious house with other girls, also named Alice, she’ll experience quite a journey. Will she find a way out and return home?

Three Emilie
YOU wake up in a bedroom and a girl, Emilie, want to tell you her story.A story about three girls called Emilie and a mysterious house.

Three stories…
All connected…
For Autism Awareness….

Les 4 Alice: Lorange Journey!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/904940/Les_4_Alice_Lorange_Journey/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
四名愛麗絲

年輕女孩在黑暗森林中行走，在篝火旁遇見神秘紅髮少女。少女愛麗絲．洛朗日告訴她一個故事，一個荒誕得不可能為真的故事，可是……

洛朗日之旅

患有自閉症的年輕少女愛麗絲．洛朗日被迫與其他女孩困在一座神秘房屋中，而她們也都叫愛麗絲。她將經歷一場非凡旅程。她能找到離開的方法，回到家嗎？

三個艾蜜莉

你在臥室醒來，一個名叫艾蜜莉的女孩想告訴你她的故事——三個名叫艾蜜莉的非自閉症女孩與一座神秘房屋的故事。

三個故事……
彼此相連……
為提高人們對自閉症的認識……

《四名愛麗絲：洛朗日之旅》！

[來源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/904940/Les_4_Alice_Lorange_Journey/]Steam[/url]]
